faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions
faq.question1: How to create an account at Chemtial?
faq.answer1: You can create an account by clicking the 'Register' button in the top right corner, then fill in the registration form with your personal data. After successful registration, you will receive a verification email to activate your account.
faq.answer2: Yes, all products at Chemtial are 100% original from authorized distributors and trusted manufacturers. We partner with renowned brands such as Merck, Sigma-Aldrich, Thermo Fisher, and others.
faq.answer3: After your order is processed and shipped, you will receive a shipping receipt number via email. You can track your order using this receipt number on the courier's website or through the 'My Orders' page in your Chemtial account.
faq.answer4: Yes, all products come with a warranty according to each brand's policy. Warranty details are listed on the product page. If you receive a damaged or incorrect product, you can file a warranty claim within 7 days of receipt.
faq.answer5: You can contact our customer service via email at inbox@chemtial.com or WhatsApp +62 852-7717-3823. Include your order number and product photos (if any) to speed up the complaint handling process.
faq.answer6: Shipping time varies depending on the destination. For US East Coast, estimated 2-3 business days. For other US regions, estimated 3-5 business days. International shipping takes 7-14 business days.
faq.answer7: There is no minimum purchase at Chemtial. You can buy any amount of products. However, to get free shipping, the minimum purchase is $50.00.
faq.answer8: Enter the voucher code at checkout before making payment. Make sure the voucher is still active and meets the minimum purchase requirements specified.
